lead.headline: South Korea Sets 2027 Tokenization Deadline, Trump Courts Hyperliquid as DeFi Protocols Face $13B Fraud Shadow
lead.tldr: Tokenization is accelerating from sovereign policy to billion-dollar mortgage pipelines, while US regulators simultaneously signal openness to DeFi incumbents and sharpen scrutiny on offshore scam operations.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why it matters for the quarter ahead.

top_signals.title: President Trump says he wants Hyperliquid to enter the US — here’s how it could happen
top_signals.summary: President Trump has expressed a desire to bring the decentralized exchange Hyperliquid into the United States. This signal suggests a potential shift in regulatory approach toward prominent DeFi protocols.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Trump's explicit naming of Hyperliquid signals that DeFi protocol compliance is becoming a bargaining chip in US trade and industrial policy, which reprices the regulatory risk premium for DEXs with sufficient scale to matter at the presidential level.

top_signals.title: 🫂 Nvidia Takes Hugging Face Into Its Embrace With $12.9b Acquisition Deal
top_signals.summary: Nvidia has entered into a $12.9 billion acquisition deal to acquire Hugging Face. The move is described as both a defensive and offensive strategic maneuver to strengthen its position in the AI ecosystem.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Nvidia's $12.9B Hugging Face acquisition tightens the AI infrastructure bottleneck and raises the competitive bar for crypto-AI convergence plays, since vertical integration in compute now demands comparable scale or niche specialization.

top_signals.title: South Korea to start tokenizing 'all types' of securities in three stages from 2027
top_signals.summary: South Korea has announced a three-stage strategic plan starting in 2027 to tokenize all types of securities. The long-term goal is to enable the on-chain settlement of these tokenized assets using stablecoins.
top_signals.why_it_matters: South Korea's three-stage securities tokenization roadmap with stablecoin settlement creates a testable sovereign template that other G20 finance ministries will benchmark, compressing the timeline for institutional on-chain infrastructure deployment.

top_signals.title: Pineapple Financial puts $1B in mortgage records on Injective27m
top_signals.summary: Pineapple Financial is integrating $1 billion in mortgage records onto the Injective blockchain. This move aims to leverage blockchain technology for the tokenization and management of real-world financial assets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Pineapple Financial's $1B mortgage record integration on Injective demonstrates that RWA tokenization is moving from pilot to production-grade pipeline, though the underwriting question remains whether on-chain provenance reduces default prediction error or merely digitizes existing friction.

top_signals.title: FinCEN ties $13B in crypto scams to non-US operations
top_signals.summary: FinCEN has identified approximately $13 billion in suspected crypto scams based on an analysis of over 33,000 reports filed between 2023 and 2025. The agency specifically linked these fraudulent transactions to operations based outside of the United States.
top_signals.why_it_matters: FinCEN's $13B scam attribution to non-US operations provides regulatory cover for stricter offshore exchange enforcement while implicitly defending domestic compliance investments as fraud prevention, which will factor into how we price jurisdictional risk for yield-bearing protocols.

on_the_radar.title: Solana August 2026 Update
on_the_radar.summary: Solana experienced significant growth in August, with SOL price increasing 41.5% and app revenue jumping to $131.3M. The network successfully conducted its first binding on-chain governance votes, approving a disinflation measure while rejecting a fee burn proposal.

on_the_radar.title: Revolut, OpenReserve get preliminary US bank approval with crypto plans18m, Revolut, OpenReserve get preliminary US bank approval with crypto plansRevolut and OpenReserve received preliminary OCC approval to form US national banks, with both planning cryptocurrency and stablecoin-related services.
on_the_radar.summary: Revolut and OpenReserve have received preliminary approval from the OCC to establish US national banks. Both entities intend to integrate cryptocurrency and stablecoin services into their banking operations.

on_the_radar.title: South Korean regulators introduce tokenized securities roadmap
on_the_radar.summary: South Korean financial regulators have unveiled a three-phase roadmap for the issuance of tokenized assets. This initiative is part of the nation's first comprehensive regulatory framework for tokenized securities, which is expected to become law in 2027.

on_the_radar.title: US bitcoin ETFs report the largest inflow day since January, worth $731 million
on_the_radar.summary: US Bitcoin ETFs experienced their largest single-day inflow since January, totaling $731 million. Analysts link this surge in capital to dovish comments made by Fed Governor Christopher Waller.

on_the_radar.title: US, UK launch joint alliance targeting crypto scam centers9m
on_the_radar.summary: The United States and United Kingdom have established a joint alliance to target and dismantle cryptocurrency scam centers. This international cooperation aims to combat fraudulent schemes and protect investors from digital asset scams.

on_the_radar.title: SoFi, Payward agree to link banking network with Kraken infrastructure
on_the_radar.summary: SoFi Technologies has partnered with Payward to integrate its banking settlement network with Kraken's digital-asset infrastructure. This move aims to bridge traditional banking systems with cryptocurrency exchange capabilities.

on_the_radar.title: Crypto Biz: AI took a back seat when Bitcoin started climbing
on_the_radar.summary: Market attention has shifted from AI-related assets back to Bitcoin as its price climbs. The report highlights increased BTC accumulation by financial firms and a growing trend toward stablecoin adoption among institutional players.

on_the_radar.title: Zcash tops $1,000 as ETF inflows ramp up and miners pile in
on_the_radar.summary: Zcash (ZEC) has surpassed the $1,000 price mark, driven by increased inflows into Grayscale's ZCSH product. However, rising network competition is beginning to impact the profitability of miners despite the token's price rally.

worth_a_read.title: Solana August 2026 Update
worth_a_read.note: Solana's August network metrics will show whether fee market redesigns are actually capturing MEV value or just redistributing validator economics ahead of the Firedancer mainnet milestone.

worth_a_read.title: Bitcoin August 2026 Update
worth_a_read.note: Bitcoin's August update should clarify whether hashprice recovery is sustaining miner CapEx commitments or merely reflecting difficulty adjustment lag, with implications for ASIC financing structures.

worth_a_read.title: 🕙 I Want to Trade Stocks in a Market That Doesn't Sleep: SEC Moves to Update Transfer Agent Rules
worth_a_read.note: Galaxy's analysis of SEC transfer agent rule updates traces the technical path for T+0 stock settlement on blockchain rails, which is the regulatory prerequisite for South Korea's 2027 stablecoin-settled securities vision.

linkedin_post:
South Korea did not ask permission. The 2027 tokenization deadline for all securities types, with stablecoin settlement as the endgame, is the clearest sovereign commitment we have seen. Sovereigns do not move in three stages unless they intend to finish.

Against this, Pineapple Financial put $1 billion in mortgage records on Injective. Not a pilot. Production pipeline. The RWA thesis is getting its first stress tests at scale.

Then Trump names Hyperliquid specifically. Not DeFi generally. One protocol. This is how compliance becomes competitive moat: the DEX large enough to be a presidential talking point gets a regulatory path, everyone else gets FinCEN's $13 billion fraud attribution to offshore operations. The split is deliberate.

We underwrite this sector on jurisdictional optionality now. The question is not whether tokenization works technically. It is whether the value accrues to the chain, the issuer, or the compliance layer in between. South Korea's roadmap makes that testable: watch which stablecoin gets named for settlement, and whether domestic banks or crypto-native issuers win the integration mandate. That single decision will reprice the entire RWA infrastructure stack.
